curriculum.title: God Gives Nineveh a Chance to Turn

core.big_idea: God's mercy reached people Jonah considered enemies.

passages.reading_note: Read in immediate context; select age-appropriate portions without changing the claim.

claims.statement: The selected passage tells the main events of God Gives Nineveh a Chance to Turn.

core.interpretation_skill: Retell sequence; identify cause and effect; connect to the big story without forced symbolism

learning.foundation_objective: Retell the main action in Jonah 3:1-10; 4:1-11 and state in simple language that god's mercy reached people jonah considered enemies.
learning.extension_objective: Place this event in the Bible's big story and name one concrete way to trust, thank, obey, or care for others in response.
